The '''1906–07 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by seven points over nearest rival [[Dundee F.C.|Dundee]].

Celtic also won the [[Scottish Cup]], the first time a club claimed the  national '[[Double (association football)|double]]'.
